hints.title: Top Left Overlap Intersection
hints.text: Every operation increments a rectangle anchored at top-left index (0, 0). The cells incremented by every single operation achieve the maximum value.

hints.title: Minimal Dimension Intersection Invariant
hints.text: The intersection of all operation rectangles is defined by the minimum row bound and the minimum column bound across all operations.

hints.title: Minimum Dimension Multiplication Procedure
hints.text: Initialize min row to m and min col to n. Loop through all operation pairs (r, c). Update min row to min(min row, r) and min col to min(min col, c). Return min row multiplied by min col.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(K) time and O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating cell additions on an m x n matrix takes O(m * n * K) time and up to 40,000^2 memory, crashing immediately.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Finding the bounding box intersection processes K operations in O(K) time and uses strictly O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should notice that all increments originate at (0, 0) and reduce the problem to finding min(r) * min(c).
